text:
Anna: quick follow-up from the postmortem on the streaming/chat flakiness — want to lock owners, timelines, and next check-ins. postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/streaming-flake-196195 (summary pinned)

Carlos: tagging the main remediation buckets i'd like concrete owners for: timeouts, partial responses, reconnects, and monitoring/alerts. @Jia @Evan can you take the parts that touch runtime routing and client logic?

Jia: I can own partial responses (rechunking + kv-cache misses). estimate: hotfix in 5 days, integration tests + rollout 2w. Will add test scenarios to the eval harness.

Evan: i'll own reconnect/backoff logic and client handshake. I'll prototype a backoff jitter change + handshake timeout clamp. target: 7 days for prototype, 3w for staged rollout.

Maya: i'll own timeouts/backend load-shedding policy tuning and SLA gating with infra. Need telemetry at per-request level first. ETA: 4 days to add enhanced metrics, 2w for policy tweak and canary.

Anna: thanks. can we list specific action items and owners here so we can track in the remediation board?

Carlos: actions i have so far:
- CAR-01: Add per-request timeout traces + tag requests that hit load-shed — owner: Maya — due: 2026-03-31
- CAR-02: Fix chunking edge-case in streaming serialization that causes truncated messages — owner: Jia — due: 2026-03-28
- CAR-03: Implement exponential backoff jitter + handshake clamp in client lib — owner: Evan — due: 2026-04-04
- CAR-04: Add dashboard + PagerDuty escalation rule for partial-response ratio > 0.5% — owner: Anna & SRE — due: 2026-03-30
- CAR-05: Run a 3-day canary for changed load-shed policy and collect p99 latency / partial response rate — owner: Maya — due: 2026-04-10

Jia: note on CAR-02 — the truncated messages look correlated with KV cache eviction at sequence boundaries. I'll add a unit test that simulates evictions during a multi-chunk stream.

Evan: on CAR-03 i'll also add client-side instrumentation that reports reconnect attempt counts and last-reconnect-reason. that'll feed the new dashboard.

Maya: for CAR-01 i'll instrument with the request_id and route tags, and surface a composite metric: requests_timed_out / requests_total by route/model. Is that ok for alerting?

Anna: yes. threshold proposal: fire P1 if partial-response ratio > 0.5% for 15m and p50 latency increase > 2x baseline. @sre-bot please create a ticket for alert tuning.

sre-bot: created ticket SRE-410 for alert tuning and assigned to Anna. link: https://redwood.internal/sre/tickets/SRE-410

incident-bot: postmortem checklist updated. follow-ups added to remediation tracker: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1962005432

Carlos: risk/rollback notes — for any change to load-shedding or client handshake we plan a staged rollout with automatic rollback if partial-response ratio increases by > 25% from baseline. document rollback steps in the PR.

Maya: i'll prepare a short runbook snippet describing how to force-disable the new LB policy and how to fall back to previous routing profiles.

Jia: will add the new unit/integration tests to CI and create a short smoke test scenario to validate no truncated outputs under high eviction rates.

Evan: proposed check-ins: weekly sync every Tue 09:30 PST, plus immediate check-in after each canary day. i'll add calendar invites.

Anna: let's meet in 2 days for a status update. please update the remediation tracker with progress and block notes before the meeting.

Carlos: quick note — any repeat patterns from earlier incidents? i saw two previous weeks with slightly elevated partials tied to model warmup churn. can we add a recurring anomaly check that highlights warmup churn correlated with partials?

Jia: yep, adding a job that correlates model-load events with partial-response spikes and posts a weekly summary to #eng-runtime.

Maya: also recommending we add a low-cost synthetic stream run from each region every hour to detect region-specific regressions early.

Anna: thanks team. owners: Maya (timeouts/load-shed/metrics), Jia (chunking/partial responses/tests), Evan (reconnect/client), Carlos (remediation board & rollback policy), Anna (alerts + coordination). next check-in: 2026-03-25 17:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Evan: noted. i'll post a short design doc for the client changes and link to the PR once ready.

sre-bot: scheduled weekly reminder for remediation check-ins every Tue 09:30 PST starting 2026-03-24.

Carlos: if anyone hits blockers, drop blockers in this thread or ping me directly. trying to keep the follow-up action items compact and traceable.

Anna: closing the thread for now — will reopen if new info. thanks everyone. :pray:
